items.title: Frank Alkyer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 10, 2020
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Monk Rowe... I have one of them here, Frank Alkyer... Thank you for meeting with me. [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you, it’s a pleasure.

ctx.x: Frank was interviewed in New Orleans, Louisiana on January 10, 2020 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive. Romy Britell participated briefly in the interview.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive in New Orleans at the 2020 Jazz Network conference and the place is crawling with jazz people, and I have one of them here, Frank Alkyer, who is the publisher of DownBeat and an author. Thank you for meeting with me.
